items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Did you ever play with Joe Oliver? Years ago, yeah, I was young, yeah. ... Joe had a brass band on there, Joe Oliver. ... I played most of the band in town.

ctx.x: Yes, I've heard of her. When did she die, by the way? What year was that about? 1942. 1942. December 10, yeah. Soon be 20 years now. Long time. Do you remember how we think of it? If you could tell us a little bit about her life. It's in this book, yeah. All them bands she played. Was she born right here too? Right here, she was good. Let me see what I can find it.

You might check on that and be sure it's all accurate. Oh yeah. They got plenty of things in this book that's wrong too. I know it. I know it. That's why I thought we better check on anything. He left here playing. I wrote it down. I got a fucking fine. He left here playing with me. I told him that he left here in 1922, but they said 23. You see why I know it? He said my wife was about to be a mother. He supposed to christendom baby. And she was born in August, 22, and left about June or July with Joe Oliver.
Yeah, I knew he went up with Oliver. Yeah. What is your birth date?
